class.name: minibot_hardware/StepperDiffDrive
class.description: ros2_control SystemInterface for a differential-drive base using NEMA-17 steppers + DRV8825 drivers commanded by an STM32F407 over a CRC-8 framed UART link. Odometry comes from the STM32's exact step-pulse tally -- there are no encoders on this robot.
